translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús ibmar-gwag-diglegedgi burbar sunmaksad
Ibagwengi Jesús gannar mata-dummad-gaka-naba-sii odurdakdebalid. Dulemar-bukidar ese ambikunonisoggu, Jesús ur-digi-naidgi nakwisad, dulemardi gakagi ambikusmalad.
Jesús urgi sii, dulemar-odurdakdebalid, bukidar ibmar-burbamaladgi sunmaksii-gusad, sogded:
“Bemar nue itomar: Ibagwengine, dule-wargwen ibmar-gwag-digedi ibmar-gwag dignaded.
Ibmar-gwag dignaigusgu, abala ibmar-gwag igargi babatidapid. Sikwimar nonigua, ibmar-gwag-igargi-babatismalad manonimalad.
“Abala akwa-yaisulidgi babatismalad, napa-askinnegwadgi. Ar agi gwae-gwae ibmar-gwag ainialid, ar ade napa-askinnegwad.
Dad gaargu, ibmar-gwag gummakdesunnad, ar e-maligan askinnesoggu, dinguded.
“Abala ibmar-gwag iko-abargi babatisad. Ibmar-gwag dungudgu, ikomar eba dungudmogad. Ikomar bur-bule ibmar-gwag-birgi obitesoggu, ibmar-gwag gwen sanmaksasulid.

“Ar ibmar-gwag napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, amardi ainiargu, dunguded, geb degi nue sanmaksad. Gwenna-gwenna akusaar sanmaksad, abala bur-nuegwad sanmaksad, deginbali, baigandi bur-napiragwad sanmaksad.”
Geb Jesús sogdebar: —Bemar mag nue itobiele, nue itomar an-bemarga-ibmar-soged.
¿Ibiga-wede Jesús burbar sunmakde-dae?
Dulemar-naded-sorba Jesús-e-sapingan e-ambe-gakabo-gued, degi, e-walikaa-bukmalad Jesússe egichiarmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Be anmarga burbar sogsad, ¿ibu we nue obarsunna?

Jesús, abin-sogded: “Ar bemargardi Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-igar-burbar-mamaid osanalegoye maid. Dulemar-baigangardi unnila ega ibmar burbar sunmakoye igar sogmaid, igi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged bato sogsa-gusa:

content.text: agi degiir, Bab Dummad e-iskudimalad ega elio-itole!”

content: Jesús ibmar-gwag-digedgi-burbar-sunmaksad odulosad

Geb degi Jesús e-sapinganga sogdebalid: “¿Burbar-an-ibmar-bemarga-sogsamaladi, amba akusunna bemar itomarmode? Degite, ¿igi an burbar bemarga ibmar-baigangi-sunmakedi mag bemar itomalosunna? Degiir an bemarga odulosunnodo:
Dule-ibmar-gwag-digedi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbagi sunmaked e-wilubgando.

“Bukidar-ibmar-gwag-igarba-babatismaladi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-itosmalad e-wilubgando. Wemar gaya-burba itosmalanad degi-inigwele, nia-saila-Satanás e-gwagegi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued-diglesad ei-ungenonikid.
“Gwenna-gwenna baigandi akwa-yaisulidgi ibmar-gwag babatismalayobdo, napa-askinnegwadgi. Amar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itosmargu, nue-weligwar abingasmalad.

Ar wemar unnila askinbi Bab-Dummad-abingasmarsoggu, ibmar-gwag-digaled maligan-askinnegwadyobdo. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-ular wilearmargu, degine, dulemar sabsur e-imakarmargu, Bab Dummadgi bangudmalad.
“Ar ibmar-gwag-iko-imbaba-babatismaladdi, we-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba abingasmalando.

Ar we-napneggi-ibmar-nanaid, degi, maniginbi bur binsaed, degine, bela-ibmar-nikaa-gudigued, amar e-gwagegi dognonigu, e-binsaed galedmalad, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-e-gwagegi-naid iedmarsunnad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag-gwen-sanmaksasulidyob gunonisundo.

“Ar ibmar-gwag-napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, we-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itosmargu, e-gwagegi nue abingasmalad. Degisoggu, igi ibmar-gwag napa-nuedgi diglesar, nue sanmak-dae, debayobi amar ibmar-nuegan imaksamarmogad. Gwenna-gwenna akusaar sanmaksad, abala bur-nuegwad sanmaksad, degine, baigandi bur-napiragwad sanmaksadyob a-dulemar gunanimogad.”
Jesús sogsa-gusad, ibmar-dukualed sanar-onolegedse daye
Degi Jesús sogdebar: “¿Ar gwallu mesa-urba siega ogalesi? ¿Degine, gabed-urba-siega gwallude ogalesi? Degisuli. Gwallu niba e-silegedgi sile-daed bela neg-mee-saegar.
Deyobi ibmar bipisaale gwen dukuosurguodo. Be-ibmar-saed bela wisgulegedsegad, amba be dukuar ibmar-saoen-inigwele, bela dulemar wisguedsegad.
Bemar mag nue itobiele, nue itomar, an-bemarga-ibmar-soged.”
Degi Jesús sogdebalid: “Nue be binsaer-gebed, igi be Bab-Dummad-itobie. Ar ade igi Bab Dummad be itoge, abayobi Bab Dummad bega ibmar-itoged ukmogoed, degine, bur-bule mag-ibmar-ito be-imakoed.
Ar ade dule-ibmar-nikadga bur-bule ibmar uklebaloed. Ar dule-ibmar-suliddina, ar bipii wis ibmar-nikad aka-bur e-annik sulegoed.”
Jesús ibmar-gwag-niedgi burbar sunmaksad
Degi Jesús sogdebar: “Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid weyobdo: Dule-gwensak ibmar-gwag napagi digeyobdo.

We-dule wichurdo, ibiga nabir ibmar-gwag nie. We-dule gwen oakalogosurdo, gabmai-dibe, atakmai-dibe, mutikidbar-dibe, ar neg-ibginbar-dibe, we-dule gwen oakalogosurdo, na e-itoleged ibmar-gwag nidagoed, geb degi na dungudbaloed.
“Ar napade ibmar-gwag nabir dunguega imaked. Gebesaila e-gagan-inse aramakoed, a-sorba geb durbamakoed, geb agine sanmakdagoed.
Geb ibmar-gwag nue goresale, geb weledagoed, ar ade weleged-ibagande warmaksad.”
Jesús burbar mostaza-e-gwaggi sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “¿Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid igi an sogmalar-gebe, igi an nue osanalomalar-gebe?
Weyobsundo: Ar igi mostaza-e-gwag napagi diglege, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba ayobmodo. Mostaza-e-gwag napneggi bur-ibmar-gwagba bipigwadid.
Degi-inigwele, mostaza-gwag-diglesad-sorba dunguderdi ibmar-dubaled-masga-gued-birgi obite-daed. E-anagan dikasur neg-gad-dasoggu, sunna sikwimar-niba-gukudimalad e-anagan-urba obunnosundo.”
Jesús dulemar-odurdakdele, burbar-sunmaksuli geg dulemar-odurdak-daed, burbar sunmakdegu-daed, mag dulemar nabir e-itogedse.
Wegi-burbale Jesús dulemar-odurdakdigusdo, e-sapingangardi bachikii bela osanalod-daed, na e-ibmar-sogsad we ibi nue obare.
Jesús burwa, degi, demar obogilesad
A-ibagi neg-sedod-gusgu, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —Mata-dummad-abin-obakar namargwelo.
Ar Jesús bato urgi sisoggu, na e-sapinganba nade-gusad. Dulemar-bukidar gakagi besmalad, baigandi ur-baidgangi eba nade-gusmalad.
Igarba nadapmargu, mataba egi burwa-dummad noalid. Burwa binnasursoggu, demar-arwedba ur doged-gualid.
Jesúsdi ursorba nono-onakwed-birgi nono-onakwiis gabmaid. E-sapingan Jesús-odaksamargu, ega sogdemalad: —¿Odurdaked-saila, baisur be anmar-dake anmar burgwisar?
Jesús gwisgusgu, burwaga sogded: “Be bogidik sae.” Geb degi demarga sogdebalid: “Be bogidik samo.” Burwa bogidik naded, bela neg swilidik sigisad.
Geb Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar yaisur dobgue? ¿Ibiga bemar Bab-Dummad-benmala? Mer Bab Dummadgi be bengumar.
Jesús-e-sapingandi bela nue-dobe itodmalad, degi, muchub-muchub na ese egichiarmalad: —¿Wede doa-dule-sunna, burwase, degi, demarse-bakar eba ibsamargu?
